mapper.sql: u.user_id, u.email_encrypted, u.user_name_encrypted, u.role, u.account_status, u.blocked_until, u.created_at, u.updated_at, COUNT(DISTINCT f.family_id) AS recipient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT g.gift_id) AS gift_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.simul_id) AS simulation_count
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user u WHERE u.role = 'USER'

SELECT FROM user u LEFT JOIN family f ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN gift g ON g.family_id = f.family_id LEFT JOIN simulation s ON s.family_id = f.family_id WHERE u.role = 'USER'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.email_encrypted, u.user_name_encrypted, u.role, u.account_status, u.blocked_until, u.created_at, u.updated_at ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM user u LEFT JOIN family f ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN gift g ON g.family_id = f.family_id LEFT JOIN simulation s ON s.family_id = f.family_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.email_encrypted, u.user_name_encrypted, u.role, u.account_status, u.blocked_until, u.created_at, u.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET account_status = 'BLOCKED', blocked_until = #{blockedUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role = 'USER' AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND blocked_until IS NULL AND #{blockedUntil} > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE user SET account_status = 'ACTIVE', blocked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role = 'USER' AND account_status = 'BLOCKED'
